patch.value: 1) CLI invokes Core Orchestrator (C8) with config (input/output/basePath, Markdown flavor, tag/link conventions, enabled plugins). 2) Orchestrator initializes a versioned BuildContext (note registry, page registry, asset registry, diagnostics). 3) collectFiles hook: File Collector plugin (C9) discovers .md files and populates note registry (R1). 4) transform hook: Markdown Parser plugin (C10) parses frontmatter + Markdown AST, extracts outbound links and candidate tags into canonical fields (R3/R7/R9). 5) resolve hook(s): Backlink Resolver (C11) builds link graph, resolves targets, attaches backlinks; Tag Aggregator (C12) builds tag index and registers tag pages (R8/R10). 6) render hook: Theme/Renderer plugin (C14) renders note pages, home/index, tag index, tag pages, and search page; copies static assets; pages reference client-side runtime (C15) and search assets (R2/R17). 7) finalize hook: Search Index plugin (C13) generates client-side index artifacts into output and registers their paths (R5). 8) Orchestrator writes build manifest + diagnostics summary and exits with non-zero status on configured fatal errors (R12/R22).
